### Do You Choose Comfort or Battle?
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-june-6-2012.html
Passage: Luke 9:23
Points:
- High church attendance does not produce spiritual impact when believers choose comfort over conviction.
- Churches often retreat into safe zones to avoid confrontation and offending the culture.
- Christ issues an inescapable call for believers to deny themselves and take up their cross daily.
- The Christian life is a spiritual battleship fought to win souls, not a comfortable cruise ship.
- Disciples must shift their aim away from personal ease toward faithfully serving the Lord.
